title: gr-scheduler components

nodes.name: SingleHtmlShell
nodes.description: Boots the page, wires every part together, holds the embedded-document slot and installs the exposure point.

nodes.name: DomSvgSurface
nodes.description: Puts the SVG string on screen.

nodes.name: DomInputSource
nodes.description: Delivers pointer and keyboard events.

nodes.name: FileSystemAccessFileStore
nodes.description: Reads and writes files and keeps the handle.

nodes.name: BrowserClipboard
nodes.description: Writes to the clipboard.

nodes.name: CanvasRasterizer
nodes.description: Turns SVG into a raster image.

nodes.name: AgentApiEndpoint
nodes.description: Installs Agent API. Not exposed by default. Eighteen flat members.

nodes.name: InputCommandTranslator
nodes.description: Turns pointer and keyboard input into one operation. Declares InputSource.

nodes.name: SvgRenderer
nodes.description: Builds the SVG string from geometry, then hands it over. Declares SvgSurface.

nodes.name: DocumentCodec
nodes.description: Converts between the document and JSON or MSPDI.

nodes.name: ImageExporter
nodes.description: Produces the image output. Declares Rasterizer.

nodes.name: FileGateway
nodes.description: Opens and overwrites the document file. Declares FileStore.

nodes.name: ClipboardGateway
nodes.description: Sends the document or the picture out. Declares Clipboard.

nodes.name: ApplyDocumentChange
nodes.description: The only write path. Checks the stamp, applies all or nothing, records history, advances the revision, notifies.

nodes.name: EditDocument
nodes.description: One pure operation per aggregate: task, group, dependency, annotation, resource, calendar, project, settings.

nodes.name: ImportDocument
nodes.description: Takes in a document and merges it.

nodes.name: UndoEdit
nodes.description: Steps the history back by one.

nodes.name: RedoEdit
nodes.description: Steps the history forward by one.

nodes.name: ValidateImportedDocument
nodes.description: Checks untrusted input. Shared by every intake path.

nodes.name: ChooseStartupDocument
nodes.description: Picks the document to open at start-up, in the given order.

nodes.name: NotifyChangeWatchers
nodes.description: Hands confirmed changes to the watchers.

nodes.name: PostDialogueMessage
nodes.description: Takes a confirmed utterance, appends it to DialogueLog and passes it on. Runtime only, never saved.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.description: The document root. Composes the three groups of table T-052 and holds the DR-1 invariant.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.description: The schedule-data group and its invariants.

nodes.name: DocumentSettings
nodes.description: The presentation group: every saved setting with its bounds.

nodes.name: DocumentStamp
nodes.description: schemaVersion, revisionStamp and changeLog, plus the pure functions that advance them.

nodes.name: EditHistory
nodes.description: The undo stack as an immutable value, replaced whole.

nodes.name: ScheduleLayout
nodes.description: Time axis, label width estimate, row placement, detail level, fit.

nodes.name: ScheduleGeometry
nodes.description: Vertices of everything drawn: bars, dependency routes, progress line, cursors, annotations, watermark.

nodes.name: ItemHitArea
nodes.description: Which item the pointer is over.

nodes.name: Selection
nodes.description: The set of selected objects and the order they were selected in. Never saved.

nodes.name: DialogueLog
nodes.description: Confirmed utterances, in an order of their own that is independent of the revision. Never saved.

nodes.name: ScreenRegions
nodes.description: The rectangle of every screen part, and which region the pointer is in.

nodes.name: ScreenState
nodes.description: The screen values the document never saves: what is armed, which surface is open, the palette and the full screen.

nodes.name: ScreenRenderer
nodes.description: Builds the description of the UI parts outside the schedule, and passes on the utterance confirmed in the dialogue field. Declares ScreenSurface.

nodes.name: DomScreenSurface
nodes.description: Puts that description on the page.
